newsitem.title: USA: Prudential, clients to buy into Meridian.
newsitem.headline: Prudential, clients to buy into Meridian.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America said Thursday that it and some "institutional clients" would buy $140 million worth of stock in Meridian Industrial Trust Inc as part of a deal reached with the real estate company.

Prudential said its General Account investment portfolio will buy stock on behalf of policyholders, while institutional client portfolios managed by Prudential Real Estate Investors will buy another amount.
In exchange, it said it will sell more than five million square feet of industrial properties plus several development sites to Meridian.

"A portfolio of 57 buildings in seven markets, in addition to the development sites in Illinois, Michigan and Southern California, are expected to be sold to (Meridian) before the end of the third quarter of 1997," it said.
"The (Meridian) stock purchase will occur at approximately the same time," it added.
On Thursday, Meridian's stock closed 1/8 down at 22 on the New York Stock Exchange.
